summary: Verified BridgeBot Scripted Mode v6 changes end-to-end: (1) pure `_decide_scripted_reply` helper, (2) enhanced GET /api/discord/scripted-counters/count with active/total/stale/reset_hours fields, (3) new POST /api/discord/scripted-mode/sandbox dry-run endpoint, and (4) Reply Sandbox UI on /admin/discord. Backend: extended /app/backend/tests/test_scripted_ai_router.py with 10 new pure-helper cases (pool_name × skip_reason matrix) — 30/30 unit tests pass (20 existing v5 + 10 new). Created /app/backend/tests/test_scripted_sandbox_http.py with 13 HTTP curl-style tests covering empty-db zeros, active row, stale row (now - reset_hours - 1), reset_hours echo, sandbox validation (empty=400, >25=400), 3-message shape, NO db writes invariant (count_documents before==after==0), saved-config fallback, and state-progression invariants (turn0=primary count=1, turn1=update count=2, exhausted/silent at end, manual_silent at count=2). All 13 pass. Frontend: Login → /admin/discord → instance switch → Scripted Mode toggle ON. counters-card displays 'Active user counters: 0' when empty; after seeding a stale row, the scripted-counters-stale span renders '+ 1 idle (will auto-reset)' and Reset Counters becomes enabled. sandbox-card, sandbox-toggle, sandbox-input, sandbox-run-btn, sandbox-clear-btn all present and functional. Empty-input toast 'Enter at least one message' shown; >25-line toast 'Max 25 messages per run' shown. A live 3-message dry-run produced turn-0=primary count_after=1, turn-1=update count_after=2, turn-2=ack count_after=3 with the correct pool-considered list (4 default acks). Clear button removes rendered turns. v5 regression labels (Reply 1 — Primary, Reply 2 — Update, Max Replies per User) all present.
critical_code_review_comments: Refactor is behavior-preserving: all 20 existing v5 test cases pass unchanged against the new wrapper. `_decide_scripted_reply` is correctly side-effect-free and `build_scripted_response` cleanly layers DB IO (idle reset + persistence + speculation skip logging) on top.

Sandbox endpoint correctly mirrors `build_scripted_response`'s state-progression: only advances count + used_replies when decision.reply is non-empty, and only pushes to used_replies when pool != 'ack'. Verified via count_documents before==after==0 that NO scripted_counters write occurs.

GET /api/discord/scripted-counters/count cutoff uses `last_at >= now - reset_hours` (ISO string lexicographic compare on UTC isoformat — safe because timezones are normalized to +00:00). Total = raw count; stale = total - active. Matches spec.
Sandbox session_id is `sandbox_{instance_id}_{timestamp}` — good for avoiding collisions with real conversations and gives the Claude classify/pick prompts a fresh context per run.
Minor: server.py is now 2655 lines — consider splitting Scripted Mode (lines ~480-640 + endpoints ~2329-2440) into a `scripted_mode.py` module for maintainability. Not blocking.

Mock pattern in test_scripted_ai_router.py uses `monkeypatch.setattr(server, '_classify_user_intent', ...)` and `monkeypatch.setattr(server, '_ai_pick_variant', ...)` — keep this pattern for any future Scripted Mode tests. For frontend stale-row test, you must seed via a direct Mongo insert and wait one 5s poll cycle (counter card auto-refreshes via loadStatus interval). The v5 hint labels and toggle-persistence fix from iter_15/iter_16 are unchanged.
